void (*eff26_jp_tbl[6])(State_Other*);

const s16 eff26_num[1] = { 1 };

const s16 eff26_data_0000[1] = { 0 };

void effect_26_move(State_Other* ewk) {
    if (obr_no_disp_check()) {
        return;
    }

    if (compel_dead_check(ewk)) {
        ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 99;
        ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
        return;
    }

    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[0]) {
    case 0:
        ewk->wu.routine_no[0]++;
        ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 0;
        ewk->wu.disp_flag = 1;
        set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, ewk->wu.char_index);
        break;

    case 1:
        if (!g_state.execute_flag && !g_state.Game_pause) {
            eff26_jp_tbl[ewk->wu.old_routine_no[2] / 2](ewk);
        }

        disp_pos_trans_entry_rs(ewk);
        break;

    case 2:
        ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
        ewk->wu.routine_no[0]++;
        break;

    case 3:
        ewk->wu.routine_no[0]++;
        break;

    default:
        all_cgps_put_back(&ewk->wu);
        Release_Effect(&ewk->wu);
        break;
    }
}

static void eff26_00(State_Other* ewk) {
    State_Other* oya = (State_Other*)ewk->my_master;

    if (oya->wu.routine_no[1] > 1) {
        ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 2;
        piece_set(ewk);
        return;
    }

    if (ewk->wu.hit_stop && !g_state.EXE_obroll) {
        char_move(&ewk->wu);
    }
}

static void eff26_01(State_Other* ewk) {
    State_Other* oya = (State_Other*)ewk->my_master;

    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {
    case 0:
        ewk->wu.routine_no[1]++;

        if (g_state.eff_hit_flag[oya->wu.type]) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 99;
            break;
        }

        /* fallthrough */

    case 1:
        if (ewk->wu.hit_stop && !g_state.EXE_obroll) {
            char_move(&ewk->wu);
        }

        if (oya->wu.routine_no[1] > 1) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1]++;
            piece_set(ewk);
            set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, ewk->wu.old_routine_no[1]);
        }

        break;

    case 2:
        if (!g_state.EXE_obroll) {
            char_move(&ewk->wu);
        }

        if (ewk->wu.cg_type == 1) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 2;
        }

        break;
    }
}

        }

        break;

        }

            ewk->wu.routine_no[1]++;

    State_Other* oya = (State_Other*)ewk->my_master;

    State_Other* oya = (State_Other*)ewk->my_master;

    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {

    case 3:

            ewk->wu.routine_no[1]++;

            if (ewk->wu.old_routine_no[2] & 1 && ewk->wu.old_routine_no[5] > 0) {
                effect_27_init(ewk, ewk->wu.old_routine_no[5]);
            }

            set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, ewk->wu.old_routine_no[3]);
        }

        /* fallthrough */

    case 4:
        if (!g_state.EXE_obroll) {
            char_move(&ewk->wu);
        }

        if (ewk->wu.cg_type == 1) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 2;
        }

static void eff26_05(State_Other* ewk) {
    State_Other* oya = (State_Other*)ewk->my_master;

    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {

void (*eff26_jp_tbl[6])(State_Other*) = { eff26_00, eff26_01, eff26_02, eff26_03, eff26_04, eff26_05 };

s32 effect_26_init(State_Other* oya, s16 type26) {
    State_Other* ewk;
    s16 ix;
    s16 lp_cnt = eff26_num[type26];
    s16 i;
    const s16* data_ptr;

    if (!lp_cnt) {
        return 0;
    }

    for (data_ptr = scr_obj_data26[type26], i = 0; i < lp_cnt; i++) {
        if ((ix = Acquire_Effect(4)) == -1) {
            return -1;
        }

        ewk = (State_Other*)frw[ix];
        ewk->wu.active_flag = 1;
        ewk->wu.id = 26;
        ewk->wu.work_id = 16;
        ewk->my_master = oya;
        ewk->wu.graphic_rom_type = 1;
        ewk->wu.facing_flag = 0;
        ewk->wu.my_col_mode = 0x4200;
        ewk->wu.death_timer = *data_ptr++;
        ewk->wu.type = (s8)*data_ptr++;
        ewk->wu.my_family = *data_ptr++;
        ewk->wu.my_col_code = *data_ptr++;
        ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos = *data_ptr++;
        ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos = *data_ptr++;
        ewk->wu.position_z = *data_ptr++;
        ewk->wu.char_index = *data_ptr++;
        ewk->wu.hit_stop = *data_ptr++;
        ewk->wu.sync_bg_strip = *data_ptr++;
        ewk->wu.old_routine_no[0] = *data_ptr++;
        ewk->wu.old_routine_no[1] = *data_ptr++;
        ewk->wu.old_routine_no[2] = *data_ptr++;
        ewk->wu.old_routine_no[3] = *data_ptr++;
        ewk->wu.old_routine_no[7] = *data_ptr++;
        ewk->wu.old_routine_no[4] = *data_ptr++;
        ewk->wu.old_routine_no[5] = *data_ptr++;
        ewk->wu.char_table[0] = char_add[g_state.bg_w.bg_index];
        suzi_offset_set(ewk);
    }

    return 0;
}

/**

#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/effect/effect_27_screen_object_piece_data.h"
#include "game_state.h"
#include "common.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/effect/effect_05_background.h"

#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/stage/stage_subroutines.h"

static void set_second_hop(State_Other* ewk);
static void dead_check27(State_Other* ewk);

void (*eff27_jp_tbl[11])(State_Other*);

const s16 scr_obj_num27[2] = { 3, 3 };

const s16 piece_0000[57] = { 2, 8492, -36, 15, 70, 7, 1, 0, 6, 0,   -16, 2,  0,      0, 0, 5, -32768, -1, -32768,
                             2, 8492, -52, 18, 10, 8, 1, 0, 6, 0,   -16, 2,  0,      0, 0, 5, -32768, -1, -32768,
                             2, 8492, -40, 22, 70, 9, 1, 0, 2, 120, 0,   -2, -32768, 0, 0, 6, 0,      -1, -32768 };

const s16 piece_0001[57] = { 2, 8492, 14,  80, 70, 51, 1, 0, 2, 32, 32, 2,  0, 0, 0, 6, -32768, -1, -24576,
                             2, 8492, -4,  96, 10, 50, 1, 0, 2, 52, 52, -2, 0, 0, 0, 7, -32768, -1, -24576,
                             2, 8492, -26, 88, 10, 49, 1, 0, 7, 16, 16, -3, 0, 0, 0, 6, -32768, -1, -12288 };

const s16* scr_obj_data27[2] = { piece_0000, piece_0001 };

void effect_27_move(State_Other* ewk) {
    State_Other* oya;

    if (obr_no_disp_check()) {
        return;
    }

    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[0]) {
    case 0:
        ewk->wu.routine_no[0]++;
        ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 0;
        ewk->wu.disp_flag = 1;
        set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, ewk->wu.char_index);
        oya = (State_Other*)ewk->my_master;
        ewk->wu.old_routine_no[3] = oya->wu.routine_no[1];
        /* fallthrough */

    case 1:
        if (compel_dead_check(ewk)) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 99;
            ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
            break;
        }

        if (!g_state.execute_flag && !g_state.Game_pause && !g_state.EXE_obroll) {
            eff27_jp_tbl[ewk->wu.old_routine_no[0]](ewk);
        }

        disp_pos_trans_entry_rs(ewk);
        break;

    case 2:
        ewk->wu.routine_no[0]++;
        ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
        break;

    case 3:
        ewk->wu.routine_no[0]++;
        break;

    default:
        all_cgps_put_back(&ewk->wu);
        Release_Effect(&ewk->wu);
        break;
    }
}

static void eff27_00(State_Other* ewk) {
    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {
    case 0:
        if (ewk->wu.hit_stop) {
            char_move(&ewk->wu);
        }

        add_x_sub(&ewk->wu);
        add_y_sub(&ewk->wu);

        if (ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos < ewk->wu.old_routine_no[1]) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1]++;
        }

        break;

    case 1:
        if (!ewk->wu.old_routine_no[0]) {
            dead_check27(ewk);
        }

        break;
    }
}

static void eff27_02(State_Other* ewk) {
    if (ewk->wu.hit_stop) {
        char_move(&ewk->wu);
    }

    add_x_sub(&ewk->wu);
    add_y_sub(&ewk->wu);

    ewk->wu.old_routine_no[1]--;

    if (ewk->wu.old_routine_no[1] < 0) {
        ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 2;
    }
}

static void eff27_03(State_Other* ewk) {
    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {
    case 0:
        if (ewk->wu.cg_type != 2) {
            char_move(&ewk->wu);
        }

        add_x_sub(&ewk->wu);
        add_y_sub(&ewk->wu);

        if (ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos < ewk->wu.old_routine_no[1]) {
            char_move_z(&ewk->wu);
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1]++;
            set_second_hop(ewk);
        }

        break;

    case 1:
        if (ewk->wu.cg_type != 2) {
            char_move(&ewk->wu);
        }

        add_x_sub(&ewk->wu);
        add_y_sub(&ewk->wu);

        if (ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos <= ewk->wu.old_routine_no[2]) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1]++;
        }

        break;

    case 2:
        if (ewk->wu.cg_type != 1) {
            char_move(&ewk->wu);
        }

        dead_check27(ewk);
        break;
    }
}

static void eff27_04(State_Other* ewk) {
    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {
    case 0:
        if (ewk->wu.cg_type != 2) {
            char_move(&ewk->wu);
        }

        add_x_sub(&ewk->wu);
        add_y_sub(&ewk->wu);

        if (ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos < ewk->wu.old_routine_no[1]) {
            char_move_z(&ewk->wu);
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1]++;
        }

        break;

    case 1:
        char_move(&ewk->wu);

        if (ewk->wu.cg_type == 1) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1]++;
        }

        break;

    case 2:
        dead_check27(ewk);
        break;
    }
}

static void eff27_05(State_Other* ewk) {
    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {
    case 0:
        if (ewk->wu.cg_type != 2) {
            char_move(&ewk->wu);
        }

        add_x_sub(&ewk->wu);
        add_y_sub(&ewk->wu);

        if (ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos < ewk->wu.old_routine_no[1]) {
            char_move_z(&ewk->wu);
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1]++;
        }

        break;

    case 1:
        char_move(&ewk->wu);

        if (ewk->wu.cg_type == 1) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1]++;
            set_second_hop(ewk);
        }

        break;

    case 2:
        eff27_03(ewk);
        break;
    }
}

static void eff27_06(State_Other* ewk) {
    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {
    case 0:
        char_move(&ewk->wu);

        if (ewk->wu.cg_type != 1) {
            break;
        }

        if (ewk->wu.old_routine_no[0] == 6) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1]++;
            break;
        }

        ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 2;
        break;

    case 1:
        break;
    }
}

static void eff27_07(State_Other* ewk) {
    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {
    case 0:
        if (ewk->wu.cg_type != 2) {
            char_move(&ewk->wu);
        }

        add_x_sub(&ewk->wu);
        add_y_sub(&ewk->wu);

        if (ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos < ewk->wu.old_routine_no[1]) {
            char_move_z(&ewk->wu);
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1]++;
            set_second_hop(ewk);
        }

        break;

    case 1:
        if (ewk->wu.cg_type != 2) {
            char_move(&ewk->wu);
        }

        add_x_sub(&ewk->wu);
        add_y_sub(&ewk->wu);

        if (ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos <= ewk->wu.old_routine_no[2]) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1]++;
        }

        break;

    case 2:
        if (ewk->wu.cg_type != 1) {
            char_move(&ewk->wu);
            break;
        }

        ewk->wu.routine_no[1]++;
        break;

    case 3:
        break;
    }
}

static void eff27_08(State_Other* ewk) {
    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {
    case 0:
        eff27_03(ewk);
        break;

    case 1:
        effect_27_init(ewk, 4);
        ewk->wu.routine_no[1]++;
        break;

    case 2:
        ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 2;
        break;
    }
}

static void eff27_09(State_Other* ewk) {
    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {
    case 0:
        char_move(&ewk->wu);

        if (ewk->wu.cg_type != 1) {
            break;
        }

        ewk->wu.routine_no[1]++;
        ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos = ewk->wu.old_routine_no[1];
        ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos = ewk->wu.old_routine_no[2];

        if (ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].real.h > 0) {
            set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].real.h);
        }

        break;

    case 1:
        char_move(&ewk->wu);
        break;
    }
}

static void set_second_hop(State_Other* ewk) {
    const s16* ptr;

    ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos = ewk->wu.old_routine_no[1];
    ewk->wu.mvxy.d[0].sp = ewk->wu.mvxy.d[0].sp >> 1;
    ewk->wu.mvxy.d[1].sp = ewk->wu.mvxy.d[1].sp >> 1;
    ptr = scr_obj_data27[ewk->wu.type];
    ptr += 11;
    ptr += ewk->wu.direction * 19;
    ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].real.h = *ptr++;
    ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].real.l = *ptr++;
    ptr += 2;
    ewk->wu.mvxy.a[1].real.h = *ptr++;
    ewk->wu.mvxy.a[1].real.l = *ptr++;
    ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp = ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp >> 1;
    ewk->wu.mvxy.a[1].sp = ewk->wu.mvxy.a[1].sp >> 1;
}

static void dead_check27(State_Other* ewk) {
    State_Other* oya = (State_Other*)ewk->my_master;

    if (ewk->wu.old_routine_no[3] != oya->wu.routine_no[1]) {
        ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 2;
    }
}

void (*eff27_jp_tbl[11])(State_Other*) = { eff27_00, eff27_00, eff27_02, eff27_03, eff27_04, eff27_05,
                                          eff27_06, eff27_06, eff27_07, eff27_08, eff27_09 };

s32 effect_27_init(State_Other* oya, s16 type) {
    State_Other* ewk;
    s16 ix;
    s16 lp_cnt = scr_obj_num27[type];
    s16 i;
    const s16* data_ptr;

    if (!lp_cnt) {
        return 0;
    }

    for (data_ptr = scr_obj_data27[type], i = 0; i < lp_cnt; i++) {
        if ((ix = Acquire_Effect(4)) == -1) {
            return -1;
        }

        ewk = (State_Other*)frw[ix];
        ewk->my_master = oya;
        ewk->wu.active_flag = 1;
        ewk->wu.id = 0x1B;
        ewk->wu.work_id = 0x10;
        ewk->wu.graphic_rom_type = 1;
        ewk->wu.facing_flag = 0;
        ewk->wu.my_col_mode = 0x4200;
        ewk->wu.type = type;
        ewk->wu.direction = i;
        ewk->wu.death_timer = 1;
        ewk->wu.my_family = *data_ptr++;
        ewk->wu.my_col_code = *data_ptr++;
        ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos = *data_ptr++;
        ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos = *data_ptr++;
        ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos += oya->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos;
        ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos += oya->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos;
        ewk->wu.my_priority = ewk->wu.position_z = *data_ptr++;
        ewk->wu.char_index = *data_ptr++;
        ewk->wu.hit_stop = *data_ptr++;
        ewk->wu.sync_bg_strip = *data_ptr++;
        ewk->wu.old_routine_no[0] = *data_ptr++;
        ewk->wu.old_routine_no[1] = *data_ptr++;
        ewk->wu.old_routine_no[2] = *data_ptr++;
        ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].real.h = *data_ptr++;
        ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].real.l = *data_ptr++;
        ewk->wu.mvxy.d[0].real.h = *data_ptr++;
        ewk->wu.mvxy.d[0].real.l = *data_ptr++;
        ewk->wu.mvxy.a[1].real.h = *data_ptr++;
        ewk->wu.mvxy.a[1].real.l = *data_ptr++;
        ewk->wu.mvxy.d[1].real.h = *data_ptr++;
        ewk->wu.mvxy.d[1].real.l = *data_ptr++;
        ewk->wu.char_table[0] = char_add[g_state.bg_w.bg_index];
        suzi_offset_set(ewk);
        ewk->wu.my_sprite_sheet = 7;
        ewk->wu.my_trans_mode = get_my_trans_mode(ewk->wu.my_sprite_sheet);
    }

    return 0;
}

#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/effect/effect_29_vanish_timeout.h"

#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/stage/target_subroutines.h"

const s16 eff29_vanish_time[8] = { 480, 600, 300, 240, 200, 340, 500, 360 };

void effect_29_move(State_Other* ewk) {
    s16 work;

    if (obr_no_disp_check()) {
        return;
    }

    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[0]) {
    case 0:
        if (!g_state.execute_flag && !g_state.Game_pause && !g_state.EXE_obroll) {
            ewk->wu.old_routine_no[0]--;

            if (ewk->wu.old_routine_no[0] <= 0) {
                ewk->wu.routine_no[0]++;
                ewk->wu.disp_flag = 1;
                set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, 0);
                break;
            }
        }

        break;

    case 1:
        if (!g_state.execute_flag && !g_state.Game_pause && !g_state.EXE_obroll) {
            char_move(&ewk->wu);

            if (ewk->wu.cg_type) {
                ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 0;
                ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
                work = random_16();
                work &= 7;
                ewk->wu.old_routine_no[0] = eff29_vanish_time[work];
            }
        }

        disp_pos_trans_entry_r(ewk);
        break;

    default:
        all_cgps_put_back(&ewk->wu);
        Release_Effect(&ewk->wu);
        break;
    }
}

s32 effect_29_init() {
    State_Other* ewk;
    s16 ix;

    if ((ix = Acquire_Effect(4)) == -1) {
        return -1;
    }

    ewk = (State_Other*)frw[ix];
    ewk->wu.active_flag = 1;
    ewk->wu.id = 29;
    ewk->wu.work_id = 16;
    ewk->wu.graphic_rom_type = 1;
    ewk->wu.facing_flag = 0;
    ewk->wu.death_timer = 1;
    ewk->wu.my_col_mode = 0x4200;
    ewk->wu.my_family = 2;
    ewk->wu.my_col_code = 300;
    ewk->wu.my_sprite_sheet = 7;
    ewk->wu.my_trans_mode = get_my_trans_mode(ewk->wu.my_sprite_sheet);
    ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos = 512;
    ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos = 0;
    ewk->wu.my_priority = ewk->wu.position_z = 82;
    ewk->wu.char_index = 0;
    ewk->wu.sync_bg_strip = 0;
    ewk->wu.char_table[0] = _hkg_char_table;
    suzi_offset_set(ewk);
    ewk->wu.old_routine_no[0] = 120;
    ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
    return 0;
}

#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/effect/effect_30_object_etc3_character.h"
#include "game_state.h"
#include "bin2obj/char_table.h"
#include "common.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/effect/effect.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/engine/calculate_direction.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/engine/charset.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/engine/slow_motion.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/engine/state_user.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/rendering/sprite_utilities.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/rendering/texture_cache.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/stage/bg.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/stage/stage_subroutines.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/stage/target_subroutines.h"

void effect_30_move(State_Other* ewk) {
    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[0]) {
    case 0:
        ewk->wu.routine_no[0]++;
        ewk->wu.disp_flag = 1;
        ewk->wu.shadow_flag = 1;
        ewk->wu.shadow_x = 0;
        ewk->wu.shadow_y = -10;
        ewk->wu.shadow_prio = 71;
        ewk->wu.shadow_char = 16;
        set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, ewk->wu.char_index);
        ewk->wu.old_routine_no[0] = 80;
        cal_initial_speed(&ewk->wu, ewk->wu.old_routine_no[0], ewk->wu.old_routine_no[1], ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos);
        break;

    case 1:
        if (!g_state.execute_flag && !g_state.Game_pause) {
            char_move(&ewk->wu);
            add_x_sub(&ewk->wu);
            add_y_sub(&ewk->wu);
            ewk->wu.old_routine_no[0]--;

            if (ewk->wu.old_routine_no[0] < 1) {
                ewk->wu.routine_no[0]++;
                set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, 1);
            }
        }

        sync_bg_strip_position(ewk);
        sort_push_request(&ewk->wu);
        break;

    case 2:
        if (!g_state.execute_flag && !g_state.Game_pause && (char_move(&ewk->wu), ewk->wu.cg_type == 0xFF)) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[0]++;
            set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, 2);
        }

        sync_bg_strip_position(ewk);
        sort_push_request(&ewk->wu);
        break;

    case 3:
        if (!g_state.execute_flag && !g_state.Game_pause && (char_move(&ewk->wu), ewk->wu.cg_type == 10)) {
            ewk->wu.cg_type = 0;
            ewk->wu.shadow_x -= 4;
        }

        sync_bg_strip_position(ewk);
        sort_push_request(&ewk->wu);
        break;

    case 4:
        ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
        ewk->wu.shadow_flag = 0;
        ewk->wu.routine_no[0]++;
        break;

    case 5:
        ewk->wu.routine_no[0]++;
        break;

    default:
        Release_Effect(&ewk->wu);
        break;
    }
}

s32 effect_30_init(State* wk) {
    State_Other* ewk;
    s16 ix;

    if ((ix = Acquire_Effect(4)) == -1) {
        return -1;
    }

    ewk = (State_Other*)frw[ix];
    ewk->wu.active_flag = 1;
    ewk->wu.id = 30;
    ewk->wu.work_id = 16;
    ewk->master_id = wk->id;
    ewk->wu.graphic_rom_type = 1;
    ewk->wu.my_col_mode = wk->my_col_mode;
    ewk->wu.my_col_code = wk->my_col_code + 1;
    ewk->wu.my_family = wk->my_family;
    ewk->my_master = wk;
    ewk->wu.facing_flag = wk->facing_flag;

    if (wk->facing_flag) {
        if (wk->xyz[0].disp.pos < g_state.bg_w.bgw[1].wxy[0].disp.pos) {
            ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos = wk->xyz[0].disp.pos - 256;
        } else {
            ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos = g_state.bg_w.bgw[1].wxy[0].disp.pos - (g_state.bg_w.pos_offset + 32);
        }

        ewk->wu.old_routine_no[1] = wk->xyz[0].disp.pos - 32;
    } else {
        if (wk->xyz[0].disp.pos > g_state.bg_w.bgw[1].wxy[0].disp.pos) {
            ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos = wk->xyz[0].disp.pos + 256;
        } else {
            ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos = g_state.bg_w.bgw[1].wxy[0].disp.pos + (g_state.bg_w.pos_offset + 32);
        }

        ewk->wu.old_routine_no[1] = wk->xyz[0].disp.pos + 32;
    }

    ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos = wk->xyz[1].disp.pos - 12;
    ewk->wu.my_priority = 28;
    ewk->wu.position_z = 28;
    ewk->wu.char_table[0] = _etc3_char_table;
    ewk->wu.char_index = 0;
    ewk->wu.sync_bg_strip = 0;
    suzi_offset_set(ewk);
    ewk->wu.my_sprite_sheet = 14;
    ewk->wu.my_trans_mode = get_my_trans_mode(ewk->wu.my_sprite_sheet);
    return 0;
}

            ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos = wk->xyz[0].disp.pos + 256;
        } else {
            ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos = g_state.bg_w.bgw[1].wxy[0].disp.pos + (g_state.bg_w.pos_offset + 32);
        }

        ewk->wu.old_routine_no[1] = wk->xyz[0].disp.pos - 80;
    }

    ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos = wk->xyz[1].disp.pos - 12;
    ewk->wu.my_priority = 28;
    ewk->wu.position_z = 28;
    ewk->wu.char_table[0] = _etc3_char_table;
    ewk->wu.char_index = 0;
    ewk->wu.sync_bg_strip = 0;
    suzi_offset_set(ewk);
    ewk->wu.my_sprite_sheet = 14;
    ewk->wu.my_trans_mode = get_my_trans_mode(ewk->wu.my_sprite_sheet);
    return 0;

void effect_32_move(State_Other* ewk) {
    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[0]) {
    case 0:
        ewk->wu.routine_no[0]++;
        ewk->wu.disp_flag = 1;
        ewk->wu.shadow_flag = 1;
        ewk->wu.shadow_x = 0;
        ewk->wu.shadow_y = -4;
        ewk->wu.shadow_prio = 71;
        ewk->wu.shadow_char = 16;
        set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, ewk->wu.char_index);
        ewk->wu.old_routine_no[0] = 120;
        cal_initial_speed(&ewk->wu, ewk->wu.old_routine_no[0], ewk->wu.old_routine_no[1], ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos);
        break;

    case 1:
        if (!g_state.execute_flag && !g_state.Game_pause) {
            char_move(&ewk->wu);
            add_x_sub(&ewk->wu);
            add_y_sub(&ewk->wu);
            ewk->wu.old_routine_no[0]--;

            if (ewk->wu.old_routine_no[0] < 1) {
                ewk->wu.routine_no[0]++;
                set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, 1);
            }
        }

        sync_bg_strip_position(ewk);
        sort_push_request(&ewk->wu);
        break;

    case 2:
        if (!g_state.execute_flag && !g_state.Game_pause && (char_move(&ewk->wu), ewk->wu.cg_type == 0xFF)) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[0]++;
            set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, 5);
        }

        sync_bg_strip_position(ewk);
        sort_push_request(&ewk->wu);
        break;

    case 3:
        if (!g_state.execute_flag && !g_state.Game_pause && (char_move(&ewk->wu), ewk->wu.cg_type == 10)) {
            ewk->wu.cg_type = 0;
            ewk->wu.shadow_x -= 8;
        }

        sync_bg_strip_position(ewk);
        sort_push_request(&ewk->wu);
        break;

    case 4:
        ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
        ewk->wu.shadow_flag = 0;
        ewk->wu.routine_no[0]++;
        break;

    case 5:
        ewk->wu.routine_no[0]++;
        break;

    default:
        Release_Effect(&ewk->wu);
        break;
    }
}

s32 effect_32_init(State* wk) {
    State_Other* ewk;
    PlayerEntity* twk;
    s16 ix;

    if ((ix = Acquire_Effect(4)) == -1) {
        return -1;
    }

    ewk = (State_Other*)frw[ix];
    ewk->wu.active_flag = 1;
    ewk->wu.id = 32;
    ewk->wu.work_id = 16;
    ewk->master_id = wk->id;
    ewk->wu.graphic_rom_type = 1;
    ewk->wu.my_col_mode = wk->my_col_mode;
    ewk->wu.my_col_code = wk->my_col_code + 1;
    ewk->wu.my_family = wk->my_family;
    ewk->my_master = wk;
    ewk->wu.target_adrs = wk->target_adrs;
    ewk->wu.facing_flag = wk->facing_flag;
    twk = (PlayerEntity*)wk->target_adrs;

    if (wk->facing_flag) {
        if (wk->xyz[0].disp.pos < g_state.bg_w.bgw[1].wxy[0].disp.pos) {
            ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos = wk->xyz[0].disp.pos - 256;
        } else {
            ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos = g_state.bg_w.bgw[1].wxy[0].disp.pos - (g_state.bg_w.pos_offset + 32);
        }

        ewk->wu.old_routine_no[1] = twk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos - 144;
    } else {
        if (wk->xyz[0].disp.pos > g_state.bg_w.bgw[1].wxy[0].disp.pos) {
            ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos = wk->xyz[0].disp.pos + 256;
        } else {
            ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos = g_state.bg_w.bgw[1].wxy[0].disp.pos + (g_state.bg_w.pos_offset + 32);
        }

        ewk->wu.old_routine_no[1] = twk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos + 144;
    }

    ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos = wk->xyz[1].disp.pos - 4;
    ewk->wu.my_priority = 36;
    ewk->wu.position_z = 36;
    ewk->wu.char_table[0] = _etc3_char_table;
    ewk->wu.char_index = 0;
    ewk->wu.sync_bg_strip = 0;
    suzi_offset_set(ewk);
    ewk->wu.my_sprite_sheet = 14;
    ewk->wu.my_trans_mode = get_my_trans_mode(ewk->wu.my_sprite_sheet);
    return 0;
}

const s16 WinLoseID[2][2];

void effect_33_move(State_Other* ewk) {
    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[0]) {
    case 0:
        ewk->wu.routine_no[0]++;
        ewk->wu.disp_flag = 1;
        ewk->wu.shadow_flag = 1;
        ewk->wu.shadow_x = 0;
        ewk->wu.shadow_y = -10;
        ewk->wu.shadow_prio = 71;
        ewk->wu.shadow_char = 16;
        set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, ewk->wu.char_index);
        break;

    case 1:
        sync_bg_strip_position(ewk);
        sort_push_request(&ewk->wu);

        if (g_state.execute_flag || g_state.Game_pause || g_state.pcon_rno[2] != 1 || g_state.Event_Judge_Gals != -1 ||
            !g_state.Complete_Judgement) {
            break;
        }

        ewk->wu.routine_no[0]++;
        break;

    case 2:
        if (!g_state.execute_flag && !g_state.Game_pause) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[0]++;
            ewk->wu.char_index = WinLoseID[ewk->master_id][g_state.Winner_id] + 10;
            set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, ewk->wu.char_index);
        }

        sync_bg_strip_position(ewk);
        sort_push_request(&ewk->wu);
        break;

    case 3:
        if (!g_state.execute_flag && !g_state.Game_pause) {
            if (ewk->wu.death_timer == 1 || g_state.Suicide[0] != 0) {
                ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
                ewk->wu.routine_no[0]++;
                break;
            }

            char_move(&ewk->wu);
        }

        sync_bg_strip_position(ewk);
        sort_push_request(&ewk->wu);
        break;

    case 4:
        ewk->wu.routine_no[0]++;
        break;

    case 5:
    default:
        Release_Effect(&ewk->wu);
        break;
    }
}

s32 effect_33_init(State* wk) {
    State_Other* ewk;
    s16 ix;

    if ((ix = Acquire_Effect(4)) == -1) {
        return -1;
    }

    ewk = (State_Other*)frw[ix];
    ewk->wu.active_flag = 1;
    ewk->wu.id = 33;
    ewk->wu.work_id = 16;

    ewk->wu.graphic_rom_type = 1;
    ewk->wu.my_col_mode = wk->my_col_mode;
    ewk->wu.my_col_code = wk->my_col_code + 1;
    ewk->wu.my_family = wk->my_family;
    ewk->my_master = wk;
    ewk->wu.facing_flag = wk->facing_flag;
    ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos = wk->xyz[0].disp.pos;
    ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos += wk->facing_flag ? -48 : 48;
    ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos = wk->xyz[1].disp.pos - 12;
    ewk->wu.my_priority = wk->my_priority - 12;
    ewk->wu.position_z = ewk->wu.my_priority - 12;

#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/stage/stage_subroutines.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/stage/target_subroutines.h"

void effect_34_move(State_Other* ewk) {
    State* oya_ptr = (State*)ewk->my_master;

    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[0]) {
    case 0:
        ewk->wu.routine_no[0]++;
        ewk->wu.disp_flag = 1;
        ewk->wu.shadow_flag = 1;
        ewk->wu.shadow_x = 0;
        ewk->wu.shadow_y = -10;
        ewk->wu.shadow_prio = 71;
        ewk->wu.shadow_char = 16;
        set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, ewk->wu.char_index);
        ewk->wu.old_routine_no[0] = 60;
        cal_initial_speed(&ewk->wu, ewk->wu.old_routine_no[0], ewk->wu.old_routine_no[1], ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos);
        break;

    case 1:
        if (g_state.execute_flag || g_state.Game_pause || g_state.bg_w.bgw[1].xy[1].disp.pos >= 104) {
            sync_bg_strip_position(ewk);
            sort_push_request(&ewk->wu);
            break;
        }

        char_move(&ewk->wu);
        sync_bg_strip_position(ewk);
        sort_push_request(&ewk->wu);

        if (ewk->wu.cg_type == 1) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[0]++;
            ewk->wu.cg_type = 0;
            oya_ptr->script_register_bank[1] = 9;
        }

        break;

    case 2:
        if (g_state.execute_flag || g_state.Game_pause) {
            sync_bg_strip_position(ewk);
            sort_push_request(&ewk->wu);
            break;
        }

        char_move(&ewk->wu);
        sync_bg_strip_position(ewk);
        sort_push_request(&ewk->wu);

        if (ewk->wu.cg_type == 0xFF) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[0]++;
            ewk->wu.facing_flag = ewk->wu.facing_flag ? 0 : 1;
            set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, 0);
        }

        break;

    case 3:
        if (g_state.execute_flag || g_state.Game_pause) {
            sync_bg_strip_position(ewk);
            sort_push_request(&ewk->wu);
            break;
        }

        if (ewk->wu.old_routine_no[0]--) {
            char_move(&ewk->wu);
            add_x_sub(&ewk->wu);
            sync_bg_strip_position(ewk);
            sort_push_request(&ewk->wu);
            break;
        }

        ewk->wu.routine_no[0]++;
        ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
        break;

    case 4:
        ewk->wu.routine_no[0]++;
        break;

    case 5:
    default:
        Release_Effect(&ewk->wu);
        break;
    }
}
s32 effect_34_init(State* wk, s32 /* unused */) {
    State_Other* ewk;
    s16 ix;

    if ((ix = Acquire_Effect(4)) == -1) {
        return -1;
    }

    ewk = (State_Other*)frw[ix];
    ewk->wu.active_flag = 1;
    ewk->wu.id = 34;
    ewk->wu.work_id = 16;

    ewk->wu.graphic_rom_type = 1;

    ewk->wu.my_family = wk->my_family;

    ewk->wu.facing_flag = wk->facing_flag;
    ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos = wk->xyz[0].disp.pos;
    ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos += wk->facing_flag ? -48 : 48;
    ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos = wk->xyz[1].disp.pos - 12;
    ewk->wu.my_priority = wk->my_priority - 12;
    ewk->wu.position_z = ewk->wu.my_priority - 12;
    ewk->wu.char_table[0] = _etc3_char_table;
    ewk->wu.sync_bg_strip = 0;
    ewk->wu.char_index = g_state.bg_w.stage == 6 ? 4 : 8;

    ewk->wu.my_sprite_sheet = 14;

void effect_35_move(State_Other* ewk) {
    void (*eff35_jp[7])(State_Other*) = { eff35_0000, eff35_0001, eff35_0002, eff35_0003,

static void eff35_0000(State_Other* ewk) {
    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {
    case 0:
        ewk->wu.old_routine_no[1]--;

        if (ewk->wu.old_routine_no[1] <= 0) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1]++;
            ewk->wu.disp_flag = 1;
            set_char_move_init2(&ewk->wu, 0, ewk->wu.char_index, ewk->wu.old_routine_no[3], 0);
        }

        break;

    case 1:
        disp_pos_trans_entry(ewk);
        break;

    default:
        all_cgps_put_back(&ewk->wu);
        Release_Effect(&ewk->wu);
        break;
    }
}

static void eff35_0001(State_Other* ewk) {
    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {
    case 0:
        if (g_state.Break_Into) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 4;
            break;
        }

        ewk->wu.old_routine_no[1]--;

        if (ewk->wu.old_routine_no[1] <= 0) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1]++;
            ewk->wu.disp_flag = 1;
            ewk->wu.mirror_flag = 1;
            ewk->wu.mirror_scale.size.x = 127;
            ewk->wu.mirror_scale.size.y = 63;
            set_char_move_init2(&ewk->wu, 0, ewk->wu.char_index, ewk->wu.old_routine_no[3], 0);
        }

        break;

    case 1:
        if (g_state.Break_Into) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 4;
            break;
        }

        ewk->wu.mirror_scale.size.x -= 12;

        if (ewk->wu.mirror_scale.size.x <= 0) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1]++;
            ewk->wu.mirror_scale.size.x = 0;
        }

        disp_pos_trans_entry5(ewk);
        break;

    case 2:
        if (g_state.Break_Into) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 4;
            break;
        }

        ewk->wu.mirror_scale.size.x += 12;

        if (ewk->wu.mirror_scale.size.x >= 63) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1]++;
            ewk->wu.mirror_scale.size.x = 63;
        }

        disp_pos_trans_entry5(ewk);
        break;

    case 3:
        if (g_state.Break_Into) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 4;
            break;
        }

        ewk->wu.old_routine_no[4]--;

        if (ewk->wu.old_routine_no[4] <= 0) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1]++;
            ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
            g_state.Next_Step = 1;
        }

        disp_pos_trans_entry5(ewk);
        break;

    case 4:
        ewk->wu.routine_no[1]++;
        break;

    default:
        all_cgps_put_back(&ewk->wu);
        Release_Effect(&ewk->wu);
        break;
    }
}

static void eff35_0002(State_Other* ewk) {

static void eff35_0003(State_Other* ewk) {
    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {
    case 0:
        ewk->wu.routine_no[1]++;
        ewk->wu.old_routine_no[4] = 0;
        /* fallthrough */

    case 1:
        if (g_state.Break_Into) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 99;
            break;
        }

        ewk->wu.old_routine_no[1]--;

        if (ewk->wu.old_routine_no[1] > 0) {
            break;
        }

        ewk->wu.routine_no[1]++;
        ewk->wu.disp_flag = 1;
        set_char_move_init2(&ewk->wu, 0, ewk->wu.char_index, ewk->wu.old_routine_no[3], 0);

        if (ewk->wu.type == 2) {
            ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos = eff35_data_tbl[2][0];
            ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.low = 0;
            ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos = eff35_data_tbl[2][1];
            ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.low = 0;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp = -0x78000;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.d[0].sp = 0;
        } else {
            ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos = eff35_data_tbl[3][0];
            ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.low = 0;
            ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos = eff35_data_tbl[3][1];
            ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.low = 0;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp = 0x5C000;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.d[0].sp = 0;
        }

        break;

    case 2:
        if (g_state.Break_Into) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 99;
            break;
        }

        if (!g_state.execute_flag && !g_state.Game_pause) {
            add_x_sub(&ewk->wu);
        }

        if (ewk->wu.type == 2) {
            if (ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos < 416) {
                ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 1;
                ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
                ewk->wu.old_routine_no[4]++;
                ewk->wu.old_routine_no[4] &= 3;
                ewk->wu.old_routine_no[1] = eff35_03_b[ewk->wu.old_routine_no[4]];
            }
        } else if (ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos > 768) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 1;
            ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
            ewk->wu.old_routine_no[4]++;
            ewk->wu.old_routine_no[4] &= 3;
            ewk->wu.old_routine_no[1] = eff35_03_s[ewk->wu.old_routine_no[4]];
        }

        disp_pos_trans_entry(ewk);
        break;

    case 99:
        ewk->wu.routine_no[1]++;
        break;

    default:
        all_cgps_put_back(&ewk->wu);
        Release_Effect(&ewk->wu);
        break;
    }
}

static void eff35_0004(State_Other* ewk) {
    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {
    case 0:
        ewk->wu.old_routine_no[1]--;

        if (ewk->wu.old_routine_no[1] <= 0) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1]++;
            ewk->wu.disp_flag = 1;
            set_char_move_init2(&ewk->wu, 0, ewk->wu.char_index, ewk->wu.old_routine_no[3], 0);
        }

        break;

    case 1:
        if (g_state.pcon_rno[0] == 2 && g_state.pcon_rno[2] >= 3) {
            if (g_state.Bonus_Game_result >= 10 || g_state.Bonus_Game_ex_result >= 10) {
                ewk->wu.routine_no[1]++;
            } else {
                ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 3;
            }
        } else if (!g_state.execute_flag && !g_state.Game_pause) {
            char_move(&ewk->wu);
        }

        disp_pos_trans_entry(ewk);
        break;

    case 2:
        if (!g_state.execute_flag && !g_state.Game_pause) {
            char_move(&ewk->wu);
        }

        if (ewk->wu.cg_type == 9) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1]++;
            set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, 8);
        }

        disp_pos_trans_entry(ewk);
        break;

    case 3:
        if (!g_state.execute_flag && !g_state.Game_pause) {
            char_move(&ewk->wu);
        }

        disp_pos_trans_entry(ewk);
        break;

    default:
        all_cgps_put_back(&ewk->wu);
        Release_Effect(&ewk->wu);
        break;
    }
}

static void eff35_0005(State_Other* ewk) {
    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {
    case 0:
        if (g_state.Break_Into) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 4;
            break;
        }

        ewk->wu.old_routine_no[1]--;

            ewk->wu.my_col_code = 0x49;
            set_char_move_init2(&ewk->wu, 0, ewk->wu.char_index, ewk->wu.old_routine_no[3], 0);
        }

        break;

    case 1:
        if (g_state.Break_Into) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 4;
            break;
        }

        ewk->wu.old_routine_no[4]--;

        if (ewk->wu.old_routine_no[4] <= 0) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1]++;
            ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
        }

        ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos = g_state.bg_w.bgw[1].wxy[0].disp.pos + eff35_data_tbl[ewk->wu.type][0];
        ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos = g_state.bg_w.bgw[1].xy[1].disp.pos + eff35_data_tbl[ewk->wu.type][1];
        disp_pos_trans_entry(ewk);
        break;

    case 2:
        ewk->wu.routine_no[1]++;
        break;

    default:
        all_cgps_put_back(&ewk->wu);
        Release_Effect(&ewk->wu);
        break;
    }
}

static void eff35_0006(State_Other* ewk) {
    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {

s32 effect_35_init(s16 wait_timer, s16 c_type) {
    State_Other* ewk;
    s16 ix;
    const s16* data_ptr;
    u8 char_num;

    if ((ix = Acquire_Effect(4)) == -1) {
        return -1;
    }

    ewk = (State_Other*)frw[ix];
    ewk->wu.id = 35;

    switch (c_type) {
    case 5:
        if (g_state.Country == COUNTRY_JAPAN || g_state.Country == COUNTRY_KOREA) {
            char_num = 5;
        } else {
            char_num = 9;
        }

        break;

    case 7:
        if (g_state.Country == COUNTRY_JAPAN || g_state.Country == COUNTRY_KOREA) {
            char_num = 7;
        } else {
            char_num = 8;
        }

        break;

    case 10:
        switch (g_state.Bonus_Game_result) {
        case 2:
            char_num = 11;
            break;

        case 3:
            char_num = 10;
            break;

        default:
            char_num = 10;
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 99;
            g_state.Next_Step = 1;
            break;
        }

        break;

    default:
        char_num = c_type;
        break;
    }

    data_ptr = eff35_data_tbl[char_num];
    ewk->wu.active_flag = 1;
    ewk->wu.old_routine_no[1] = wait_timer;
    ewk->wu.type = char_num;
    ewk->wu.work_id = 16;
    ewk->wu.graphic_rom_type = 1;
    ewk->wu.my_col_mode = 0x4200;
    ewk->wu.char_table[0] = _bns_char_table;
    ewk->wu.my_col_code = 0x12C;
    ewk->wu.my_sprite_sheet = 7;
    ewk->wu.my_trans_mode = get_my_trans_mode(ewk->wu.my_sprite_sheet);
    ewk->wu.my_family = 2;
    ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos = *data_ptr++;
    ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos = *data_ptr++;
    ewk->wu.my_priority = ewk->wu.position_z = *data_ptr++;
    ewk->wu.char_index = *data_ptr++;
    ewk->wu.old_routine_no[3] = *data_ptr++;
    ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = *data_ptr++;
    ewk->wu.old_routine_no[4] = *data_ptr++;
    return 0;
}

// forward decls
static void eff36_move00(State_Other* ewk);
static void eff36_move01(State_Other* ewk);
static void eff36_move02(State_Other* ewk);
static void eff36_move03(State_Other* ewk);

void effect_36_move(State_Other* ewk) {
    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[0]) {
    case 0:
        if (ewk->wu.old_routine_no[1] <= op_w.index) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[0] += 1;
        } else if (ewk->wu.old_routine_no[2] <= op_w.index) {
            switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {
            case 0:
                eff36_move00(ewk);
                break;

            case 1:
                eff36_move01(ewk);
                break;

            case 2:
                eff36_move02(ewk);
                break;

            case 3:
                eff36_move03(ewk);
                break;

            case 4:
                eff36_move04(ewk);
                break;

            case 5:
                eff36_move05(ewk);
                break;

            case 6:
                eff36_move06(ewk);
                break;

            default:
                break;
            }
        }

        break;

    default:
        Release_Effect(&ewk->wu);
        break;
    }
}

static void eff36_move00(State_Other* ewk) {
    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[2]) {
    case 0:
        ewk->wu.routine_no[2] += 1;
        ewk->wu.disp_flag = 1;
        set_char_move_init2(&ewk->wu, 0, ewk->wu.old_routine_no[0], ewk->wu.char_index, 0);
        ewk->wu.mirror_flag = 1;
        ewk->wu.mirror_scale.size.x = 63;
        ewk->wu.mirror_scale.size.y = 63;
        push_color_trans_req(ewk->wu.my_col_code & 0x1FF, 0);
        ewk->wu.my_col_code = 0;
        break;

    case 1:
        ewk->wu.mirror_scale.size.x += 1;
        ewk->wu.mirror_scale.size.y += 1;

        if (ewk->wu.mirror_scale.size.x >= 88) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[2] += 1;
            ewk->wu.mirror_scale.size.x = 88;
            ewk->wu.mirror_scale.size.y = 88;
        }

        disp_pos_trans_entry5(ewk);
        break;
    }
}

const s16 eff36_04_tbl[4] = { 0, 5, 9, 13 };

static void eff36_move04(State_Other* ewk) {
    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[2]) {
    case 0:
        ewk->wu.routine_no[2] += 1;
        ewk->wu.disp_flag = 1;
        ewk->wu.old_routine_no[6] = 4;
        set_char_move_init2(&ewk->wu, 0, ewk->wu.old_routine_no[0], ewk->wu.char_index, 0);
        push_color_trans_req((ewk->wu.my_col_code & 0x1FF) + 2, 1);
        ewk->wu.my_col_code = 0;
        break;

    case 1:
        if (ewk->wu.old_routine_no[6] <= 0) {
            ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
        } else {
            ewk->wu.old_routine_no[6] -= 1;
        }

        if ((gSeqStatus[0] >= eff36_04_tbl[ewk->wu.routine_no[2]]) && (gSeqStatus[0] != 0x74)) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[2] += 1;
            ewk->wu.disp_flag = 1;
            ewk->wu.old_routine_no[6] = 4;
            set_char_move_init2(&ewk->wu, 0, ewk->wu.old_routine_no[0], 0x17, 0);
        }

        disp_pos_trans_entry(ewk);
        break;

    case 2:
        if (ewk->wu.old_routine_no[6] <= 0) {
            ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
        } else {
            ewk->wu.old_routine_no[6] -= 1;
        }

        if (gSeqStatus[0] >= eff36_04_tbl[ewk->wu.routine_no[2]]) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[2] += 1;
            ewk->wu.disp_flag = 1;
            ewk->wu.old_routine_no[6] = 4;
            set_char_move_init2(&ewk->wu, 0, ewk->wu.old_routine_no[0], 0x18, 0);
        }

        disp_pos_trans_entry(ewk);
        break;

    case 3:
        if (ewk->wu.old_routine_no[6] <= 0) {
            ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
        } else {
            ewk->wu.old_routine_no[6] -= 1;
        }

        if (gSeqStatus[0] >= eff36_04_tbl[ewk->wu.routine_no[2]]) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[2] += 1;
            ewk->wu.disp_flag = 1;
            ewk->wu.old_routine_no[6] = 4;
            set_char_move_init2(&ewk->wu, 0, ewk->wu.old_routine_no[0], 0x19, 0);
        }

        disp_pos_trans_entry(ewk);
        break;

    case 4:
        disp_pos_trans_entry(ewk);
        break;
    }
}

static void eff36_move05(State_Other* ewk) {
    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[2]) {
    case 0:
        ewk->wu.routine_no[2] += 1;

static void eff36_move06(State_Other* ewk) {
    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[2]) {
    case 0:
        ewk->wu.routine_no[2] += 1;
        ewk->wu.disp_flag = 1;
        set_char_move_init2(&ewk->wu, 0, ewk->wu.old_routine_no[0], ewk->wu.char_index, 0);
        push_color_trans_req((ewk->wu.my_col_code & 0x1FF) + 0x15, 8);

        ewk->wu.my_col_code = 8;
        ewk->wu.mirror_flag = 1;
        ewk->wu.mirror_scale.size.x = 66;
        ewk->wu.mirror_scale.size.y = 66;
        disp_pos_trans_entry5(ewk);
        ewk->wu.old_routine_no[6] = 2;
        break;

    case 1:
        ewk->wu.old_routine_no[6] -= 1;

        if (ewk->wu.old_routine_no[6] <= 0) {
            ewk->wu.old_routine_no[6] = 2;
            ewk->wu.mirror_scale.size.x += 1;
            ewk->wu.mirror_scale.size.y += 1;

            if (ewk->wu.mirror_scale.size.x >= 127) {
                ewk->wu.routine_no[2] += 1;
                ewk->wu.mirror_scale.size.x = 127;
                ewk->wu.mirror_scale.size.y = 127;
            }
        }

        /* fallthrough */

    case 2:
        disp_pos_trans_entry5(ewk);
        break;
    }
}

s32 effect_36_init(u8 typenum) {
    State_Other* ewk;
    s16 ix;
    const s16* data_ptr;

    if (Debug_w[DEBUG_OPENING_TEST] & 0x10) {
        return 0;
    }

    if ((ix = Acquire_Effect(3)) == -1) {
        return -1;
    }

    ewk = (State_Other*)frw[ix];
    data_ptr = eff36_data_tbl[typenum];
    ewk->wu.id = 0x24;
    ewk->wu.active_flag = 1;
    ewk->wu.work_id = 0x10;
    ewk->wu.type = typenum;
    ewk->wu.graphic_rom_type = 1;
    ewk->wu.my_col_mode = 0x4200;
    ewk->wu.char_table[0] = _op_char_table;
    ewk->wu.my_family = 2;
    ewk->wu.my_sprite_sheet = 9;
    ewk->wu.my_trans_mode = get_my_trans_mode(ewk->wu.my_sprite_sheet);
    ewk->wu.my_col_code = 0x12C;
    ewk->wu.my_col_code += *data_ptr++;
    ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = *data_ptr++;
    ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos = *data_ptr++;
    ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos = *data_ptr++;
    ewk->wu.my_priority = ewk->wu.position_z = *data_ptr++;
    ewk->wu.old_routine_no[0] = *data_ptr++;
    ewk->wu.char_index = *data_ptr++;
    ewk->wu.old_routine_no[2] = *data_ptr++;
    ewk->wu.old_routine_no[1] = *data_ptr++;
    effect_36_move(ewk);
    return 0;
}

 */

#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/effect/effect_38_quake_base_xy.h"
#include "game_state.h"
#include "bin2obj/char_table.h"
#include "common.h"
#include "port/sdl/rmlui/rmlui_char_select.h"
#include "port/sdl/rmlui/rmlui_phase3_toggles.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/effect/effect.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/engine/calculate_direction.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/engine/charset.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/engine/player_control.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/engine/state_user.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/rendering/sprite_utilities.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/rendering/texture_cache.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/screen/character_select_data.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/stage/bg.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/stage/stage_subroutines.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/system/system_subroutines.h"

static void EFF38_WAIT(State_Other* ewk);
static void EFF38_SUDDENLY(State_Other* ewk);
static void EFF38_SLIDE_IN(State_Other* ewk);
static void Exit_Slide_in_38(State_Other* ewk);
static void EFF38_SLIDE_OUT(State_Other* ewk);
static void EFF38_KILL(State_Other* ewk);
static void EFF38_SHIFT(State_Other* ewk);
static s32 Shift_38(State_Other* ewk);
static s32 Move_X_Sub_38(State_Other* ewk);
static s32 Move_Y_Sub_38(State_Other* ewk, s16 Target_Y);
static void EFF38_MOVE(State_Other* ewk);

const s16 EFF38_Base_XY[2][2][2] = { { { -64, 16 }, { -128, 32 } }, { { 64, 16 }, { 128, -32 } } };

void (*const EFF38_Jmp_Tbl[7])() = { EFF38_WAIT,  EFF38_SLIDE_IN, EFF38_SLIDE_OUT, EFF38_SUDDENLY,
                                     EFF38_SHIFT, EFF38_MOVE,     EFF38_KILL };

/* eff38 draws the character portrait (body sprite) on the char select screen. */
void effect_38_move(State_Other* ewk) {
    EFF38_Jmp_Tbl[ewk->wu.routine_no[0]](ewk);

    if (ewk->wu.active_flag != 0) {
        ewk->wu.position_x = ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos & 0xFFFF;
        ewk->wu.position_y = ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos & 0xFFFF;

        bool suppress_native = false;
        if (rmlui_screen_select && rmlui_char_select_visible) {
            suppress_native = true;
        }

        if (!suppress_native) {
            sort_push_request4(&ewk->wu);
        }
    }
}

static void EFF38_WAIT(State_Other* ewk) {
    if ((ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = g_state.Order[ewk->wu.dir_old])) {
        ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 0;
        ewk->wu.routine_no[6] = 0;
    }
}

static void EFF38_SUDDENLY(State_Other* ewk) {
    if (--g_state.Order_Timer[ewk->wu.dir_old] == 0) {
        ewk->wu.disp_flag = 1;
        g_state.Order[ewk->wu.dir_old] = 0;
        ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 0;
        ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos = ewk->wu.hit_quake;
        set_char_move_init2(&ewk->wu, 0, ewk->wu.char_index, ewk->wu.dir_step + 1, 0);
    }
}

static void EFF38_SLIDE_IN(State_Other* ewk) {
    u16 cut = Cut_Cut_Sub(3);

    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[6]) {
    case 0:
        if (g_state.Order[ewk->wu.dir_old] != 1) {
            if (ewk->master_id == 0) {
                ewk->wu.hit_quake = g_state.bg_w.bgw[ewk->wu.my_family - 1].wxy[0].disp.pos - 128;
                ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos = ewk->wu.vital_new =
                    g_state.bg_w.bgw[ewk->wu.my_family - 1].wxy[1].disp.pos + 32;
            } else {
                ewk->wu.hit_quake = g_state.bg_w.bgw[ewk->wu.my_family - 1].wxy[0].disp.pos + 128;
                ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos = ewk->wu.vital_new =
                    g_state.bg_w.bgw[ewk->wu.my_family - 1].wxy[1].disp.pos - 32;
            }

            g_state.Order[ewk->wu.dir_old] = 1;
            break;
        }

        if (--g_state.Order_Timer[ewk->wu.dir_old] == 0) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[6]++;
            ewk->wu.disp_flag = 1;
            set_char_move_init2(&ewk->wu, 0, ewk->wu.char_index, ewk->wu.dir_step + 1, 0);
        }

        break;

    case 1:
        ewk->wu.xyz[0].cal += ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp * cut;
        ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp += ewk->wu.mvxy.d[0].sp;

        if (0 < ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp) {
            if (ewk->wu.hit_quake <= ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos) {
                Exit_Slide_in_38(ewk);
            }
        } else if (ewk->wu.hit_quake >= ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos) {
            Exit_Slide_in_38(ewk);
        }

        break;
    }
}

static void Exit_Slide_in_38(State_Other* ewk) {
    ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos = ewk->wu.hit_quake;

    if (--g_state.Select_Start[ewk->master_id] < 0) {
        g_state.Select_Start[ewk->master_id] = 0;
    }

    ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 0;
    ewk->wu.routine_no[6] = 0;

    if (g_state.Order[ewk->wu.dir_old] != 1) {
        ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = g_state.Order[ewk->wu.dir_old];
        return;
    }

    if (ewk->wu.vital_old == 0x7F) {
        ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 5;
        g_state.Order[ewk->wu.dir_old] = 5;
        return;
    }

    ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 0;
    g_state.Order[ewk->wu.dir_old] = 0;
}

static void EFF38_SLIDE_OUT(State_Other* ewk) {
    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[6]) {
    case 0:
        if (--g_state.Order_Timer[ewk->wu.dir_old] == 0) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[6]++;

            if (g_state.Order_Dir[ewk->wu.dir_old] == 8) {
                ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp = 0xF0000;
                ewk->wu.mvxy.d[0].sp = 0x8000;
            } else {
                ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp = -0xF0000;
                ewk->wu.mvxy.d[0].sp = -0x8000;
            }
        }

        break;

    case 1:
        ewk->wu.xyz[0].cal += ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp;
        ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp += ewk->wu.mvxy.d[0].sp;

        if (Ck_Range_Out_S(ewk, ewk->wu.my_family - 1, 80)) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[6]++;
            ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
        }

        break;

    default:
        Release_Effect(&ewk->wu);
        break;
    }
}

static void EFF38_KILL(State_Other* ewk) {
    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {
    case 0:
        if (--g_state.Order_Timer[ewk->wu.dir_old] == 0) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1]++;
            ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
        }

        break;

    default:
        Release_Effect(&ewk->wu);
        break;
    }
}

static void EFF38_SHIFT(State_Other* ewk) {
    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {
    case 0:
        if (--g_state.Order_Timer[ewk->wu.dir_old] != 0) {
            break;
        }

        ewk->wu.routine_no[1]++;

        if (ewk->master_id == 0) {
            ewk->wu.hit_quake = g_state.bg_w.bgw[ewk->wu.my_family - 1].wxy[0].disp.pos +
                                EFF38_Base_XY[ewk->master_id][1][0] +
                                EFF38_Correct_Data[ewk->master_id][1][ewk->wu.dir_step][0];
            ewk->wu.vital_new = g_state.bg_w.bgw[ewk->wu.my_family - 1].wxy[1].disp.pos +
                                EFF38_Base_XY[ewk->master_id][1][1] +
                                EFF38_Correct_Data[ewk->master_id][1][ewk->wu.dir_step][1];
            ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp = -0x60000;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.a[1].sp = 0x30000;
            cal_delta_speed(&ewk->wu, 10, ewk->wu.hit_quake, ewk->wu.vital_new, 1, 1);
            ewk->wu.dir_timer = 10;
        } else {
            ewk->wu.hit_quake = 128 + g_state.bg_w.bgw[ewk->wu.my_family - 1].wxy[0].disp.pos +
                                EFF38_Correct_Data[ewk->master_id][1][ewk->wu.dir_step][0];
            ewk->wu.vital_new = -32 + g_state.bg_w.bgw[ewk->wu.my_family - 1].wxy[1].disp.pos +
                                EFF38_Correct_Data[ewk->master_id][1][ewk->wu.dir_step][1];
            ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp = 0x60000;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.a[1].sp = -0x30000;
            cal_delta_speed(&ewk->wu, 10, ewk->wu.hit_quake, ewk->wu.vital_new, 1, 1);
            ewk->wu.dir_timer = 10;
        }

        break;

    case 1:
        if (Shift_38(ewk)) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 5;
            g_state.Order[ewk->wu.dir_old] = 5;
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 0;
            ewk->wu.routine_no[6] = 0;

            if (--g_state.Select_Start[ewk->master_id] < 0) {
                g_state.Select_Start[ewk->master_id] = 0;
            }
        }

        break;
    }
}

static s32 Shift_38(State_Other* ewk) {
    s16 ix;
    s16 loop;

    if (g_state.Scene_Cut) {
        loop = 3;
    } else {
        loop = 1;
    }

    for (ix = 0; ix < loop; ix++) {
        Move_X_Sub_38(ewk);
        Move_Y_Sub_38(ewk, ewk->wu.vital_new);

        if (--ewk->wu.dir_timer == 0) {
            return 1;
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

static s32 Move_X_Sub_38(State_Other* ewk) {
    ewk->wu.xyz[0].cal += ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp;
    ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp += ewk->wu.mvxy.d[0].sp;

    if (0 < ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp) {
        if (ewk->wu.hit_quake <= ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos) {
            ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos = ewk->wu.hit_quake;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp = 0;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.d[0].sp = 0;
            return 1;
        }

        return 0;
    }

    if (ewk->wu.hit_quake >= ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos) {
        ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos = ewk->wu.hit_quake;
        ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp = 0;
        ewk->wu.mvxy.d[0].sp = 0;
        return 1;
    }

    return 0;
}

static s32 Move_Y_Sub_38(State_Other* ewk, s16 Target_Y) {
    ewk->wu.xyz[1].cal += ewk->wu.mvxy.a[1].sp;
    ewk->wu.mvxy.a[1].sp += ewk->wu.mvxy.d[1].sp;

    if (0 > ewk->wu.mvxy.a[1].sp) {
        if (Target_Y >= ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos) {
            ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos = Target_Y;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.a[1].sp = 0;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.d[1].sp = 0;
            return 1;
        }
    } else if (Target_Y <= ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos) {
        ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos = Target_Y;
        ewk->wu.mvxy.a[1].sp = 0;
        ewk->wu.mvxy.d[1].sp = 0;
        return 1;
    }

    return 0;
}

static void EFF38_MOVE(State_Other* ewk) {
    if (g_state.Order[ewk->wu.dir_old] != 5) {
        ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = g_state.Order[ewk->wu.dir_old];
        ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 0;
        ewk->wu.routine_no[6] = 0;
        return;
    }

    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {
    case 0:
        if (g_state.Sel_PL_Complete[ewk->master_id] || g_state.plw[ewk->master_id].wu.pl_operator == 0) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 2;
        } else {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1]++;
        }

        break;

    case 1:
        if (ewk->wu.dir_step !=
            g_state.ID_of_Face[g_state.Cursor_Y[ewk->master_id]][g_state.Cursor_X[ewk->master_id]]) {
            ewk->wu.dir_step = g_state.ID_of_Face[g_state.Cursor_Y[ewk->master_id]][g_state.Cursor_X[ewk->master_id]];
            ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos = g_state.bg_w.bgw[ewk->wu.my_family - 1].wxy[0].disp.pos +
                                      EFF38_Base_XY[ewk->master_id][g_state.Play_Type][0] +
                                      EFF38_Correct_Data[ewk->master_id][g_state.Play_Type][ewk->wu.dir_step][0];
            ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos = g_state.bg_w.bgw[ewk->wu.my_family - 1].wxy[1].disp.pos +
                                      EFF38_Base_XY[ewk->master_id][g_state.Play_Type][1] +
                                      EFF38_Correct_Data[ewk->master_id][g_state.Play_Type][ewk->wu.dir_step][1];

            if (ewk->master_id == 0 && ewk->wu.dir_step == 0) {
                ewk->wu.dir_step = 23;
            }

            set_char_move_init2(&ewk->wu, 0, ewk->wu.char_index, ewk->wu.dir_step + 1, 0);
        }

        if (g_state.Sel_PL_Complete[ewk->master_id]) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1]++;
        }

        break;

    case 2:
        break;
    }
}

s32 effect_38_init(s16 PL_id, s16 dir_old, s16 Your_Char, s16 Play_Status, s16 Target_BG) {
    State_Other* ewk;
    s16 ix;

    if ((ix = Acquire_Effect(4)) == -1) {
        return -1;
    }

    ewk = (State_Other*)frw[ix];
    ewk->wu.active_flag = 1;
    ewk->wu.id = 38;
    ewk->wu.work_id = 16;
    ewk->wu.my_col_code = 0x90;
    ewk->wu.my_family = Target_BG + 1;
    ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos = g_state.bg_w.bgw[ewk->wu.my_family - 1].wxy[1].disp.pos + 16;
    ewk->wu.char_index = 2;
    *ewk->wu.char_table = _sel_pl_char_table;
    ewk->master_id = PL_id;
    ewk->wu.dir_old = Play_Status;
    ewk->wu.dir_old = dir_old;
    ewk->wu.vital_old = Your_Char;
    ewk->wu.my_sprite_sheet = 13;
    ewk->wu.my_trans_mode = get_my_trans_mode(ewk->wu.my_sprite_sheet);

    if (Your_Char == 0x7F) {
        ewk->wu.dir_step = g_state.ID_of_Face[g_state.Cursor_Y[ewk->master_id]][g_state.Cursor_X[ewk->master_id]];

        if (ewk->wu.dir_step == 0 && PL_id == 0) {
            ewk->wu.dir_step = 23;
        }
    } else {
        ewk->wu.dir_step = Your_Char;
    }

    ewk->wu.facing_flag = PL_id ^ 1;

    if (PL_id) {
        if (g_state.My_char[PL_id] == 21) {
            ewk->wu.dir_step++;
        }

        ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos = g_state.bg_w.bgw[ewk->wu.my_family - 1].wxy[0].disp.pos + 272;
        ewk->wu.position_z = 75;
        ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp = -0xF0000;
        ewk->wu.mvxy.d[0].sp = -0x8000;
        ewk->wu.mvxy.d[1].sp = 0;

        if (Play_Status == 0) {
            ewk->wu.hit_quake = g_state.bg_w.bgw[ewk->wu.my_family - 1].wxy[0].disp.pos +
                                EFF38_Base_XY[ewk->master_id][0][0] +
                                EFF38_Correct_Data[ewk->master_id][0][ewk->wu.dir_step][0];
            ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos = ewk->wu.vital_new = g_state.bg_w.bgw[ewk->wu.my_family - 1].wxy[1].disp.pos +
                                                          EFF38_Base_XY[ewk->master_id][0][1] +
                                                          EFF38_Correct_Data[ewk->master_id][0][ewk->wu.dir_step][1];
        } else {
            ewk->wu.hit_quake = g_state.bg_w.bgw[ewk->wu.my_family - 1].wxy[0].disp.pos +
                                EFF38_Base_XY[ewk->master_id][1][0] +
                                EFF38_Correct_Data[ewk->master_id][1][ewk->wu.dir_step][0];
            ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos = ewk->wu.vital_new = g_state.bg_w.bgw[ewk->wu.my_family - 1].wxy[1].disp.pos +
                                                          EFF38_Base_XY[ewk->master_id][1][1] +
                                                          EFF38_Correct_Data[ewk->master_id][1][ewk->wu.dir_step][1];
        }
    } else {
        if (Your_Char != 0x7F && g_state.My_char[PL_id] == 0) {
            ewk->wu.dir_step = 0x17;
        }

        ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos = g_state.bg_w.bgw[ewk->wu.my_family - 1].wxy[0].disp.pos - 272;
        ewk->wu.position_z = 77;
        ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp = 0xF0000;
        ewk->wu.mvxy.d[0].sp = 0x8000;
        ewk->wu.mvxy.d[1].sp = 0;

        if (Play_Status == 0) {
            ewk->wu.hit_quake = g_state.bg_w.bgw[ewk->wu.my_family - 1].wxy[0].disp.pos +
                                EFF38_Base_XY[ewk->master_id][0][0] +
                                EFF38_Correct_Data[ewk->master_id][0][ewk->wu.dir_step][0];
            ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos = ewk->wu.vital_new = g_state.bg_w.bgw[ewk->wu.my_family - 1].wxy[1].disp.pos +
                                                          EFF38_Base_XY[ewk->master_id][0][1] +
                                                          EFF38_Correct_Data[ewk->master_id][0][ewk->wu.dir_step][1];
        } else {
            ewk->wu.hit_quake = g_state.bg_w.bgw[ewk->wu.my_family - 1].wxy[0].disp.pos +
                                EFF38_Base_XY[ewk->master_id][1][0] +
                                EFF38_Correct_Data[ewk->master_id][1][ewk->wu.dir_step][0];
            ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos = ewk->wu.vital_new = g_state.bg_w.bgw[ewk->wu.my_family - 1].wxy[1].disp.pos +
                                                          EFF38_Base_XY[ewk->master_id][1][1] +
                                                          EFF38_Correct_Data[ewk->master_id][1][ewk->wu.dir_step][1];
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

/**

#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/effect/effect_39_quake.h"

static void EFF39_WAIT(State_Other* ewk);
static void EFF39_SUDDENLY(State_Other* ewk);
static void EFF39_SLIDE_IN(State_Other* ewk);
static void EFF39_SLIDE_OUT(State_Other* ewk);
static void EFF39_KILL(State_Other* ewk);
static void EFF39_MOVE(State_Other* ewk);
static s32 Get_Pos39(State_Other* ewk, s16 Who, s16 Get_Type);

void (*const EFF39_Jmp_Tbl[6])() = {
    EFF39_WAIT, EFF39_SLIDE_IN, EFF39_SLIDE_OUT, EFF39_SUDDENLY, EFF39_MOVE, EFF39_KILL
};

/* eff39 draws the character name labels on the char select screen.
 * Suppress rendering when the RmlUI overlay provides the same UI. */
void effect_39_move(State_Other* ewk) {
    EFF39_Jmp_Tbl[ewk->wu.routine_no[0]](ewk);

    if (ewk->wu.active_flag != 0) {
        ewk->wu.position_x = ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos & 0xFFFF;
        ewk->wu.position_y = ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos & 0xFFFF;
        if (!rmlui_char_select_visible)
            sort_push_request4(&ewk->wu);
    }
}

static void EFF39_WAIT(State_Other* ewk) {
    if ((ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = g_state.Order[ewk->wu.dir_old])) {
        ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 0;
        ewk->wu.routine_no[6] = 0;
    }
}

static void EFF39_SUDDENLY(State_Other* ewk) {
    if (--g_state.Order_Timer[ewk->wu.dir_old] != 0) {
        return;
    }

    ewk->wu.disp_flag = 1;
    g_state.Order[ewk->wu.dir_old] = 0;
    ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 0;
    ewk->wu.routine_no[6] = 0;
    ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos =
        g_state.bg_w.bgw[ewk->wu.my_family - 1].wxy[0].disp.pos + Name_Pos_Data[ewk->master_id][1][ewk->wu.dir_step][0];
    ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos =
        g_state.bg_w.bgw[ewk->wu.my_family - 1].wxy[1].disp.pos + Name_Pos_Data[ewk->master_id][1][ewk->wu.dir_step][1];
    set_char_move_init2(&ewk->wu, 0, ewk->wu.char_index, ewk->wu.dir_step + 1, 0);
}

static void EFF39_SLIDE_IN(State_Other* ewk) {
    if (g_state.Order[ewk->wu.dir_old] == 5) {
        ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 5;
        ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 0;
        return;
    }

    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[6]) {
    case 0:
        if (--g_state.Order_Timer[ewk->wu.dir_old] != 0) {
            break;
        }

        ewk->wu.routine_no[6]++;
        ewk->wu.disp_flag = 1;

        if (ewk->master_id) {
            ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp = -0xF0000;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.d[0].sp = 0;
            ewk->wu.hit_quake =
                g_state.bg_w.bgw[ewk->wu.my_family - 1].wxy[0].disp.pos + Get_Pos39(ewk, ewk->wu.dir_step, 0);
            ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos = ewk->wu.hit_quake + 256;
            ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos =
                g_state.bg_w.bgw[ewk->wu.my_family - 1].wxy[1].disp.pos + Get_Pos39(ewk, ewk->wu.dir_step, 1);
        } else {
            ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos = g_state.bg_w.bgw[ewk->wu.my_family - 1].wxy[0].disp.pos - 272;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp = 0xF0000;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.d[0].sp = 0;
            ewk->wu.hit_quake = Get_Pos39(ewk, ewk->wu.dir_step, 0) + 512;
            ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos = ewk->wu.hit_quake - 256;
            ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos =
                g_state.bg_w.bgw[ewk->wu.my_family - 1].wxy[1].disp.pos + Get_Pos39(ewk, ewk->wu.dir_step, 1);
        }

        set_char_move_init2(&ewk->wu, 0, (s16)(ewk->wu.char_index), (ewk->wu.dir_step) + 1, 0);
        break;

    default:
        ewk->wu.xyz[0].cal += ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp;
        ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp += ewk->wu.mvxy.d[0].sp;

        if (0 < ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp) {
            if (ewk->wu.hit_quake <= ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos) {
                ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 4;
                g_state.Order[ewk->wu.dir_old] = 4;
                ewk->wu.routine_no[6] = 0;
                ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos = ewk->wu.hit_quake;

                if (--g_state.Select_Start[ewk->master_id] < 0) {
                    g_state.Select_Start[ewk->master_id] = 0;
                }
            }

            break;
        }

        if (ewk->wu.hit_quake >= ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 4;
            g_state.Order[ewk->wu.dir_old] = 4;
            ewk->wu.routine_no[6] = 0;
            ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos = ewk->wu.hit_quake;

            if (--g_state.Select_Start[ewk->master_id] < 0) {
                g_state.Select_Start[ewk->master_id] = 0;
            }
        }

        break;
    }
}

static void EFF39_SLIDE_OUT(State_Other* ewk) {
    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[6]) {
    case 0:
        if (ewk->wu.disp_flag == 0) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 99;
        } else {
            if (--g_state.Order_Timer[ewk->wu.dir_old]) {
                break;
            }

            ewk->wu.routine_no[6]++;
        }

        if (g_state.Order_Dir[ewk->wu.dir_old] == 4) {
            ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp = -0xF0000;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.d[0].sp = 0;
        } else {
            ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp = 0xF0000;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.d[0].sp = 0;
        }

        break;

    case 1:
        ewk->wu.xyz[0].cal += ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp;
        ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp += ewk->wu.mvxy.d[0].sp;

        if (Ck_Range_Out_S(ewk, ewk->wu.my_family - 1, 48)) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[6]++;
            ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
        }

        break;

    default:
        Release_Effect(&ewk->wu);
        break;
    }
}

static void EFF39_KILL(State_Other* ewk) {
    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {
    case 0:
        if (--g_state.Order_Timer[ewk->wu.dir_old] == 0) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1]++;
            ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
        }

        break;

    default:
        Release_Effect(&ewk->wu);
        break;
    }
}

static void EFF39_MOVE(State_Other* ewk) {
    if (g_state.Order[ewk->wu.dir_old] != 4) {
        ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = g_state.Order[ewk->wu.dir_old];
        ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 0;
        ewk->wu.routine_no[6] = 0;
        return;
    }

    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {
    case 0:
        if (g_state.Sel_PL_Complete[ewk->master_id] || g_state.plw[ewk->master_id].wu.pl_operator == 0) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 2;
        } else {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1]++;
        }

        /* fallthrough */

    case 1:
        if (ewk->wu.dir_step !=
            g_state.ID_of_Face[g_state.Cursor_Y[ewk->master_id]][g_state.Cursor_X[ewk->master_id]]) {
            ewk->wu.dir_step = g_state.ID_of_Face[g_state.Cursor_Y[ewk->master_id]][g_state.Cursor_X[ewk->master_id]];
            ewk->wu.dir_step += chkNameAkuma(ewk->wu.dir_step, 9);
            ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos =
                g_state.bg_w.bgw[ewk->wu.my_family - 1].wxy[0].disp.pos + Get_Pos39(ewk, ewk->wu.dir_step, 0);
            ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos =
                g_state.bg_w.bgw[ewk->wu.my_family - 1].wxy[1].disp.pos + Get_Pos39(ewk, ewk->wu.dir_step, 1);
            set_char_move_init2(&ewk->wu, 0, ewk->wu.char_index, ewk->wu.dir_step + 1, 0);
        }

        if (g_state.Sel_PL_Complete[ewk->master_id]) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1]++;
        }

        break;

    case 2:
        break;
    }
}

s32 effect_39_init(s16 PL_id, s16 dir_old, s16 Your_Char, s16 Target_BG, s16 Option) {
    State_Other* ewk;
    s16 ix;

    if ((ix = Acquire_Effect(4)) == -1) {
        return -1;
    }

    ewk = (State_Other*)frw[ix];
    ewk->wu.active_flag = 1;
    ewk->wu.id = 39;
    ewk->wu.work_id = 16;
    ewk->wu.my_col_code = 0x2090;
    ewk->wu.my_family = Target_BG + 1;
    ewk->wu.position_z = 71;
    ewk->wu.char_index = 1;
    *ewk->wu.char_table = _sel_pl_char_table;
    ewk->master_id = PL_id;
    ewk->wu.dir_old = dir_old;
    ewk->wu.my_sprite_sheet = 13;
    ewk->wu.my_trans_mode = get_my_trans_mode(ewk->wu.my_sprite_sheet);

    if (Your_Char == 0x7F) {
        ewk->wu.dir_step = g_state.ID_of_Face[g_state.Cursor_Y[ewk->master_id]][g_state.Cursor_X[ewk->master_id]];
    } else {
        ewk->wu.dir_step = Your_Char;
    }

    ewk->wu.dir_step += chkNameAkuma(ewk->wu.dir_step, 9);
    ewk->wu.dir_step += chkNameSuv(ewk->wu.dir_step, 2);

    if (Option == 1) {
        effect_59_init(ewk, ewk->wu.my_family, 5, 1);
    }

    return 0;
}

static s32 Get_Pos39(State_Other* ewk, s16 Who, s16 Get_Type) {
    return Name_Pos_Data[ewk->master_id][g_state.Play_Type][Who][Get_Type];
}

#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/effect/effect_40_position_data.h"
#include "game_state.h"

static void EFF40_EXIT(State_Other* ewk);
static void EFF40_BACK(State_Other* ewk);
static void EFF40_ARROW(State_Other* ewk);

void (*const EFF40_Jmp_Tbl[4])() = { EFF40_EXIT, EFF40_BACK, EFF40_ARROW, EFF40_ARROW };

const s16 Pos_Data_40[4][3] = { { 0, 77, 70 }, { 0, 77, 72 }, { 0, 77, 68 }, { 0, 77, 68 } };

void effect_40_move(State_Other* ewk) {
    Check_Pos_OBJ2(ewk);

    if (g_state.Menu_Suicide[ewk->master_player]) {
        Release_Effect(&ewk->wu);
        return;
    }

    if (ewk->master_id) {
        ewk->wu.active_move = save_w[1].extra_option.contents[g_state.Menu_Page_Buff][g_state.Menu_Max];
    } else {
        ewk->wu.active_move = system_dir[1].contents[g_state.Menu_Page_Buff][g_state.Menu_Max];
    }

    EFF40_Jmp_Tbl[ewk->wu.routine_no[0]](ewk);
    sort_push_request4(&ewk->wu);
}

static void EFF40_EXIT(State_Other* ewk) {
    if (g_state.Menu_Cursor_Y[0] == g_state.Menu_Max && ewk->wu.active_move == ewk->master_priority) {
        ewk->wu.my_clear_level = 0;
    } else {
        ewk->wu.my_clear_level = 128;
    }
}

static void EFF40_BACK(State_Other* ewk) {
    s16 ix;

    if (g_state.Menu_Cursor_Y[0] == g_state.Menu_Max && ewk->wu.active_move == ewk->master_priority) {
        ix = 1;
    } else {
        ix = 0;
    }

    set_char_move_init2(&ewk->wu, 0, ewk->wu.char_index, ix + 1, 0);
}

static void EFF40_ARROW(State_Other* ewk) {
    if (g_state.Menu_Cursor_Y[0] != g_state.Menu_Max) {
        set_char_move_init2(&ewk->wu, 0, 76, (ewk->master_priority / 2) + 1, 0);
        ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 0;
    } else if (ewk->wu.active_move == ewk->master_priority) {
        if (ewk->wu.routine_no[1] == 0) {
            set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, ewk->wu.dir_step);
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 1;
        } else {
            char_move(&ewk->wu);
        }
    } else {
        set_char_move_init2(&ewk->wu, 0, 76, (ewk->master_priority / 2) + 1, 0);
        ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 0;
    }
}

s32 effect_40_init(s16 id, s16 type, s16 char_ix, s16 sync_bg, s16 master_player, s16 master_priority) {
    State_Other* ewk;
    s16 ix;

    if ((ix = Acquire_Effect(4)) == -1) {
        return -1;
    }

    ewk = (State_Other*)frw[ix];
    ewk->wu.active_flag = 1;
    ewk->wu.disp_flag = 1;
    ewk->wu.id = 40;
    ewk->wu.work_id = 16;
    ewk->wu.my_col_code = 0x1AC;
    ewk->master_id = id;
    ewk->wu.type = type;
    ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = type;
    ewk->wu.char_index = char_ix;
    ewk->wu.dir_step = char_ix;
    ewk->wu.my_family = sync_bg + 1;
    ewk->master_player = master_player;
    ewk->master_priority = master_priority;
    *ewk->wu.char_table = _sel_pl_char_table;
    ewk->wu.my_sprite_sheet = 13;
    ewk->wu.my_trans_mode = get_my_trans_mode(ewk->wu.my_sprite_sheet);
    ewk->wu.position_x = g_state.bg_w.bgw[ewk->wu.my_family - 1].wxy[0].disp.pos + Pos_Data_40[type][0];
    ewk->wu.position_y = g_state.bg_w.bgw[ewk->wu.my_family - 1].wxy[1].disp.pos + Pos_Data_40[type][1];
    ewk->wu.position_z = Pos_Data_40[type][2];

    if (master_priority < 2) {
        set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, ewk->wu.char_index);
    } else {
        set_char_move_init2(&ewk->wu, 0, 76, (ewk->master_priority / 2) + 1, 0);
    }

    return 0;
}

#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/effect/effect_41_super_art_sign.h"

static void eff41_process_01(State_Other* ewk, PlayerEntity* mwk);

void (*const eff41_main_process[2])() = { eff41_process_00, eff41_process_01 };

void effect_41_move(State_Other* ewk) {
    PlayerEntity* mwk = (PlayerEntity*)ewk->my_master;

    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[0]) {
    case 0:
        ewk->wu.routine_no[0]++;
        ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 0;
        ewk->wu.disp_flag = 1;
        ewk->wu.my_col_mode = 0x4200;
        ewk->wu.my_col_code = 0xA;
        ewk->wu.position_z = 24;

        switch (sa_sign_data[ewk->wu.type][3]) {
        case 1:
            g_state.sa_gauge_flash[mwk->wu.id] |= 4;
            break;
        case 2:
            g_state.sa_gauge_flash[mwk->wu.id] |= 4;
            break;
        }

        set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, sa_sign_data[ewk->wu.type][2]);
        goto jump;

    case 1:
        if (ewk->wu.death_timer == 1 || mwk->wu.routine_no[1] != 4) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[0]++;
            ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
            break;
        }

        if (g_state.execute_flag == 0 && g_state.Game_pause == 0) {
            if (ewk->wu.hit_stop) {
                ewk->wu.hit_stop--;
            } else {
                char_move(&ewk->wu);
            }
        }

        if (ewk->wu.cg_type == 4) {
            ewk->wu.cg_type = 0;
            effect_D9_init(mwk, 7);
        }

        if (ewk->wu.cg_type == 0xFF) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[0]++;
            ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
            return;
        }

    jump:
        eff41_main_process[sa_sign_data[ewk->wu.type][4]](ewk, mwk);
        ewk->wu.cg_type = 0;

        if (ewk->wu.extra_col != 0) {
            push_color_trans_req(ewk->wu.extra_col & 0x1FF, 10);
            ewk->wu.extra_col = 0;
        }

        sort_push_request(&ewk->wu);
        break;

    case 2:
        erase_my_shell_ix((State*)ewk->my_master, ewk->wu.myself);
        ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 3;
        break;

    default:
        Release_Effect(&ewk->wu);
        break;
    }
}

static void eff41_process_00(State_Other* ewk, PlayerEntity* mwk) {
    if (ewk->wu.cg_type == 1) {
        gauge_minus(ewk, mwk);
    }

    ewk->wu.position_x = mwk->wu.position_x;

    if (mwk->wu.facing_flag) {
        ewk->wu.position_x -= sa_sign_data[ewk->wu.type][0];
    } else {
        ewk->wu.position_x += sa_sign_data[ewk->wu.type][0];
    }

    ewk->wu.position_y = mwk->wu.position_y + sa_sign_data[ewk->wu.type][1];
}

static void eff41_process_01(State_Other* ewk, PlayerEntity* mwk) {
    switch (ewk->wu.cg_type) {
    case 1:
        gauge_minus(ewk, mwk);
        ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 1;
        break;

    case 2:
        ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 2;
        break;
    }

    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {
    case 1:
        ewk->wu.position_x = mwk->wu.position_x;
        ewk->wu.position_y = 0;
        break;

    case 2:
        ewk->wu.position_x = g_state.bg_w.bgw[1].position_x + g_state.bg_w.pos_offset;
        ewk->wu.position_y = mwk->wu.position_y + sa_sign_data[ewk->wu.type][1];
        break;

    default:
        ewk->wu.position_x = mwk->wu.position_x;

        if (mwk->wu.facing_flag) {
            ewk->wu.position_x -= sa_sign_data[ewk->wu.type][0];
        } else {
            ewk->wu.position_x += sa_sign_data[ewk->wu.type][0];
        }

        ewk->wu.position_y = mwk->wu.position_y + sa_sign_data[ewk->wu.type][1];
        break;
    }
}

static void gauge_minus(State_Other* ewk, PlayerEntity* mwk) {
    switch (sa_sign_data[ewk->wu.type][3]) {
    case 1:
        mwk->sa->super_effect_can_activate = -1;
        grade_add_super_arts(mwk->wu.id, 1);
        break;

    case 2:
        mwk->sa->super_effect_meter = -1;
        grade_add_super_arts(mwk->wu.id, 2);
        break;
    }
}

s32 effect_41_init(PlayerEntity* wk, u8 data) {
    State_Other* ewk;
    s16 ix;

    if (g_state.test_flag) {
        return 0;
    }

    if ((ix = Acquire_Effect(3)) == -1) {
        return -1;
    }

    ewk = (State_Other*)frw[ix];
    write_my_shell_ix(&wk->wu, ix);
    ewk->wu.active_flag = 1;
    ewk->wu.type = data;
    ewk->wu.id = 41;
    ewk->wu.work_id = 16;
    ewk->wu.my_sprite_sheet = 15;
    ewk->wu.my_family = wk->wu.my_family;
    ewk->my_master = wk;
    ewk->master_work_id = wk->wu.work_id;
    ewk->master_id = wk->wu.id;
    *ewk->wu.char_table = _plef_char_table;
    return 0;
}

#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/effect/effect_42_quake.h"
